- fight marrow and Aldred, losing, get help for Kairos, free him, defeat Aldred and Marrow, Kairos shows up, world goes to hell, Kairos is trying to set Khal Daraan free
- final final battle against Kairos begins, info from Kairos mind to Ivys tells him they need to release Balthazaar to defeat him, use the artifacts to release Balthazaar, kill Kairos, win game!
